WITH quarterly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        toYear(fs.DateKey) AS sales_year,
        toQuarter(fs.DateKey) AS sales_quarter,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS quarter_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS psc
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        toYear(fs.DateKey),
        toQuarter(fs.DateKey)
),
category_quarter_share AS (
    SELECT
        product_category,
        sales_year,
        sales_quarter,
        quarter_sales,
        sum(quarter_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category, sales_year) AS annual_sales,
        quarter_sales / sum(quarter_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category, sales_year) AS quarter_share_of_annual_sales
    FROM quarterly_sales
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    sales_year,
    sales_quarter,
    quarter_sales,
    annual_sales,
    quarter_share_of_annual_sales
FROM category_quarter_share
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY quarter_share_of_annual_sales DESC, sales_year, sales_quarter) = 1
ORDER BY quarter_share_of_annual_sales DESC, product_category;
